sources.source: HYG v4.4 (Hipparcos-Yale-Gliese Database, D. Nash / astronexus)
sources.epoch: ICRS/J2000.0 equinox and coordinate epoch; HYG has already propagated Hipparcos source positions to J2000.0.
sources.credit: HYG Stellar Database by David Nash / Astronexus. Prepared derivatives licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0.
sources.modifications: Complete row set reordered into a spatial hierarchy; exact HIP matches adopt existing detailed body astrometry at the fixed scene epoch, preserving HYG apparent magnitude at the Sun. Other coordinates are unchanged. Luminosity-weighted proxies and 32-color display quantization.

qualification: Local generated assets; no network publication. HYG astrometry is a local stellar neighbourhood, not a full Milky Way stellar census.
